title: Carlos de Haes
content: According to Wikipedia,Carlos de Haes(Belgian/Spanish, 1829–1898) "believed that the end result of art should be the truth found in the imitation of nature, the source of all beauty.""The painter should imitate nature as closely as possible, and to do so, you must know nature and not rely on imagination. Leaving behind Romanticism, he was early to embrace theen plein airstyle, working from outdoor preparatory sketches which were completed within a workshop."-----Carlos de Haeson Wikipedia
